llm.summary: This skill is mostly a disclosed bid-analysis integration, but it stores credentials and preserves login-bypass signed links in durable reports, which warrants careful review before use.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses network access to vendor domains and, if no API key exists, asks to collect platform, CPU architecture, and a hashed MAC for automatic account creation; this is disclosed and user-gated, but broader than simple report generation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time hooks, dependency installation, tool replacement, or remote code execution behavior was found in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly requires original API-returned URLs containing sk免登录 signature parameters to be shown and embedded in reports, which can spread access-bearing links beyond the active session.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes generated reports under ~/zlbx-bid-decision-files and persists an auto-created API key in ~/.zlbx/config.json; it also persists signed source URLs inside HTML/JSON reports.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: it guides an agent through bid analysis using the vendor API and renders an HTML report. The renderer is a supplemental report generator, not the whole skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a China-focused vendor API workflow that may create an account, store an API key locally, save bid reports to disk, and include signed免登录 source links in shareable reports. Treat generated HTML/JSON reports and recharge links as sensitive; avoid forwarding them broadly unless the signed links are acceptable to share.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: SKILL.md and references define a real API-driven analysis workflow; render_report.py is only the HTML rendering helper, so the package is not merely a display script.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: scripts/render_report.py was present and fully inspectable in this workspace.
[SDI-4] expected: Downgraded: the auto-registration document clearly states that user consent is required before feature collection or registration requests, though the pseudocode itself omits that consent gate.
[SDI-2] expected: Partially accepted: device-feature collection is disclosed, minimized to platform/arch/mac_hash, and user-gated, but it is still a privacy-sensitive onboarding flow for a bid-analysis skill.
[SDI-1] expected: Partially accepted: API key creation and persistence support the vendor API workflow and are disclosed, but they create durable account state outside the skill directory.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: the report instructions require preserving sk免登录 parameters in visible links and exported reports, creating durable access-bearing URLs without redaction or audience controls.
[SSD-3] unexpected: Accepted: signed URLs are intentionally exposed and embedded in shareable artifacts; this is not deceptive, but it is an overbroad access-sharing pattern.
[SC3] expected: Downgraded: the large base64 value is an embedded PNG logo used for offline HTML reports, not executable obfuscation.
[LP3] expected: Downgraded: local report and credential write locations are explicitly disclosed in SKILL.md, though the persisted locations still matter for user review.
[E1] expected: Partially accepted: external transmission is limited to vendor endpoints and supports API onboarding/queries, but automatic registration transmits device-derived data after consent.
[RA2] expected: Accepted as a review concern: the skill intentionally persists an auto-generated API key for future sessions in ~/.zlbx/config.json.
